title: shape index
description: Written by the builder to <world>/kantobridge/shape_index.json (docs/specs/VOXEL_BLOCKS_PLAN.md §4.2): the world's shape keys. Pixel-free names of shapes (which rule, which tile ids and offsets); each client builds their geometry from its own art. Canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact); shapeIndexHash is its SHA-256, so the planner version and parameters are inside the hash. Keys come from the whole export, never from a build's map filter. A geom id is an index into geoms; a shape id is an index into instances plus 1 (0: no shape).

planner.description: The planner and its version, e.g. kb-shapes/1.

atlases.description: Sorted atlas image ids; keys refer to them by index.

palettes.description: Sorted palette ids; instances refer to them by index.

geoms.description: Sorted canonical shape keys (cube, slab, roof, tuft, cell, tmpl); geom id = index.

templates.description: Per structure signature, its tile grid, door cells, ground tile and outdoor flag (from V7).

instances.description: Sorted [geomId, paletteIndex] pairs; shape id = index + 1.
